newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti net debt end-Sept 2.415 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti net debt end-Sept 2.415 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's information technology company Olivetti said in a statement that its net debt at September 30 1996 was 2.415 trillion lire.
The group had previously reported that its net debt had risen sharply to 2.39 trillion lire at end-August from 1.26 trillion lire at end-June 1996.
The group statement said the end-September debt figure came after trade receivables of 560 billion lire and after deferred payments to suppliers of 41 billion lire.
This gave a total net financial requirement at September 30 of 3.016 trillion lire after 3.059 trillion lire at August 31, the statement added.

Olivetti said that group operations in September generated cash of 131 billion lire, of which 88 billion lire was used during the month as Olivetti's quota to complete a capitalisation of Omnitel according to its business plan.
Olivetti is the major shareholder in Italian mobile phone consortium Omnitel.
The group added that the statement had been agreed with Consob, Italy's stock exchange regulatory body.
